text.en:
The Sitio of Allere in the Municipality of Salvador, Province of Lanao del Norte, is separated
from Barangay Salvador and constituted into a new barangay of the said municipality to be known as
Barangay Inasagan.

The Commission on Elections shall conduct and supervise the plebiscite which shall be held
within one hundred twenty days from the approval of this Act. The expenses for the conduct of the plebiscite
shall be funded out of the appropriations of the Commission on Elections provided for the purpose in Batas
Pambansa Blg. 131.

After ratification by the majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite, the President shall appoint the
officials of the new barangay.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: February 8, 1982
